incidents.name: BRA double tax without pair sync
incidents.notes: BRA's _transfer() charges a double tax to the liquidity pair without calling sync(), so the attacker could skim() the resulting imbalance out of the pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: BRA 0x449fea37d339a11efe1b181e5d5462464bba3752 created 2022-10-12T11:39:37Z by 0xcbb1568753e0616d582c4b88d65d27d99e182dc6, unrelated to attack sender 0x67a909f2953fb1138bea4b60894b51291d2d0795; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss converted from the 819 BNB reported across the two attack transactions (675.72 WBNB in this one, verified onchain): 819 BNB x $273.24 at incidentTimestamp 1673325640 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $223,787. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): keccak(eth_getCode) is identical at the creation block 22110532 and the incident block 24655772, the token holds no EIP-1967/beacon/implementation slot, the exploit trace contains no DELEGATECALL out of the token at all, and the one delegatecall in the verified source - future(address,string), gated on _ExtenAddress - cannot change the token's own runtime.
